missions.name: Landsat 9
missions.summary: Launched in 2021 into a sun-synchronous orbit about 705 km up. Its two imagers see 11 wavelengths of light, including heat, and with Landsat 8 it images the whole planet every 8 days.
missions.checked: NASA Science Landsat 9 pages: launch 27 Sep 2021, 705 km, 98.2 degree sun-synchronous orbit, OLI-2 and TIRS-2, 11 wavelengths, 8-day repeat with Landsat 8.

missions.name: Terra (MODIS)
missions.summary: Terra's MODIS instrument spots active fires by their heat in infrared light, from a near-polar sun-synchronous orbit. Its fire data reaches firefighters through NASA's FIRMS service.
missions.checked: NASA Earthdata and FIRMS pages: near-polar sun-synchronous orbit, about 10:30 local crossing, active fires found in thermal infrared (4 and 11 micrometre bands), 1 km pixels, fire data since November 2000.

missions.name: NISAR
missions.summary: Launched in July 2025 into a sun-synchronous orbit about 747 km up. Its radar sees through clouds, day or night, and can track floods, even under trees.
missions.checked: NASA NISAR mission overview and water pages: launch 30 Jul 2025, 747 km, 98.4 degree sun-synchronous orbit, 12-day repeat, L-band radar works through clouds day or night, tracks floods under vegetation.

missions.name: TROPICS
missions.summary: A team of small CubeSats, each about the size of a loaf of bread, that watch storms. Four were launched in May 2023, and together they can look at a storm about once an hour.
missions.checked: NASA news release and small-satellite blog: 3U CubeSats, four launched on two Rocket Lab launches in May 2023, microwave radiometer, median revisit about 60 minutes.

missions.name: GOES-R series
missions.summary: Weather satellites that hover over one spot from geostationary orbit. The first launched in 2016; their main imager sees 16 bands of light to watch weather all the time.
missions.checked: NASA pages on GOES-R: four satellites (R, S, T, U), first launched November 2016, Advanced Baseline Imager with 16 spectral bands, run by an integrated NOAA-NASA office.
